description: A function, sync or async, that runs inside a Transition. React tracks it until its Promise settles.
`startTransition(async () => { ... })`: React 19 keeps `isPending` true until the async function finishes.
First value returned by `useTransition()`. `true` from the moment an Action starts until every queued Action finishes.
State updates after an `await` lose the Transition context. Wrap them in another `startTransition` to keep them non-urgent.
`fetch` resolves for HTTP errors such as 500. Check `response.ok` to detect a failed request.
